import os,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
assert os.getuid()==0
assert not pathlib.Path('/var/run/docker.sock').exists()
assert not pathlib.Path('/root/.hermes/config.yaml').exists()
assert not pathlib.Path('/opt/onia-platform/app.env').exists()
assert pathlib.Path('/input/development_job.py').is_file()
assert pathlib.Path('/home/onia/.claude/.credentials.json').is_file()
for p in ['/input/development_job.py','/home/onia/.claude/.credentials.json','/opt/claude']:
 try:
  f=open(p,'r+b');f.close();raise AssertionError('mount unexpectedly writable')
 except OSError:pass
try:
 pathlib.Path('/rootfs-write-probe').write_text('x');raise AssertionError('rootfs writable')
except OSError:pass
with tempfile.TemporaryFile(dir='/work'):pass
assert not any(k.startswith(('ANTHROPIC_','AWS_','GOOGLE_','CLAUDE_CODE_USE_')) for k in os.environ)
v=subprocess.run(['/opt/claude','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
assert v.returncode==0 and '2.1.288' in v.stdout
q=subprocess.run(['/opt/claude','auth','status','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
a=json.loads(q.stdout)
assert q.returncode==0 and a.get('loggedIn') is True and a.get('authMethod')=='claude.ai' and a.get('apiProvider')=='firstParty' and str(a.get('subscriptionType','')).startswith('max')
print(json.dumps({'probe':'PASS','loggedIn':True,'authMethod':'claude.ai','apiProvider':'firstParty','subscriptionType':a['subscriptionType'],'uid':os.getuid(),'version_verified':'2.1.288'}))
